description: Aggregates of the November 2026 real world trial: testwitness 0.1.0 run commit to commit on the 15 most recent merged pull requests that touch tests in each of 20 popular open source repositories, every medium and high finding judged by hand against the diff. Per rule counts only; no repository, person or pull request is named. The hook grading is computed from these judged findings (a working tree check gives the same findings as the commit check), not from a rerun of the hook. The severities are what each rule said before the v0.1 cap on unproven rules (packages/core/src/proven.ts). pullRequestsAtDefault and pullRequestsFailOnMedium grade with the default blocking list at the time of the trial (A002, R004, R005, W002, W003, W006). Of the rules that list and the current one (A002, R003, R004, R005, W006) do not share, none has a medium or high finding in the trial, so the grading is the same for the current list.
